name: Weather
reason: Folks, this is a cool, wet pattern with highs averaging only 18.8C and nearly 41 mm of rain stirring and flushing the lake, which is just about the worst setup for a bloom.
evidence: Average max temperature of 18.8C is well below the 30C threshold that favours cyanobacteria
Zero hot days this week, so no sustained heat to stratify the water
Rain total of 40.9 mm means heavy mixing and flushing
Early October timing means declining sunshine and cooling water
